description: Modern Music Server and Streamer, compatible with Subsonic/Airsonic.

promotion.reason: Qualified on 2026-09-10 and approved by the owner. A real install proved it starts, opens to a usable screen, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data intact, and removes everything it created. 0.63.2 is the current release, built 2026-07-11, published for six architectures. It is one container with no database of its own, and the only folder it touches outside its own is the music folder you choose, mounted read-only.

data_storage: Local Store managed folder / navidrome, plus a folder you choose
risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Reads and writes a folder on this computer that you choose during setup. Nothing outside that folder is shared with it.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.

Reads your music folder to build a library from it. It never writes to that folder — the share is read-only — and it keeps the library, play counts and accounts it builds in its own managed folder. The first person to open it creates the administrator account.
